narration_directive:
[Japanese domestic drama / shuraba and sukattō contract]
Write an ORIGINAL Japanese fictional domestic relationship drama for adult viewers, especially ages 40–60. Target 13–15 minutes, 36 illustrated scenes. This is relationship fiction, not historical documentary or a factual crime report. Do not promise RPM, virality, monetization, or demographic retention. Open narration verbatim with the configured fiction disclaimer, within the first scene's character/time budget; repeat it at the beginning of the publish description. Never falsely claim real consultation/testimonial origins. User-provided cases are reference material, not publishable verbatim scripts. Fictionalize names, places, employers, housing and identifying combinations; use original dialogue and substantial new causal details, avoiding traceable retellings or named real people.
Localize to contemporary Japan: suburban rail commutes, everyday homes, rental deposits or mortgage payments instead of Korean jeonse, plausible family/address conventions and natural Japanese speech. No Korean apartment brands or names. Five connected acts: apparently peaceful marriage and a subtle inconsistency; concrete betrayal and unfair family pressure; protagonist quietly preserves legitimate evidence and consults appropriate professionals; a private, decisive presentation of evidence and accountability; a plausible settlement/separation and the protagonist's new routine. Make the reversal earned, not a sudden magical document. Maintain one protagonist and clear chronology. Alternate restrained narration and motivated short dialogue with stable speaker identity. Convey anger through actions, not repetitive screaming. A bittersweet calm ending is allowed; no mandatory sermon.
Exclude murder, serious injury, graphic violence, sexual descriptions, victim blaming and minors in sexual contexts. Do not instruct spying, hacking, trespass or public doxxing. A lawyer/detective is optional and never guaranteed to produce evidence. Do not invent exact compensation, guaranteed court outcomes or automatic employer demotion: relevant law and circumstances require primary-source verification, otherwise keep consequences qualitative and explicitly fictional. Accountability must be proportional; avoid mob harassment, revenge porn or glorifying social destruction.
Every image prompt uses the configured watercolor/clean-line base, modern Japan and consistent adults. Produce 30–40 reusable STILL illustrations (default 36); required video clip count zero. No AI video prompts. Generated artwork contains NO dialogue/text; optional lower captions or comic balloons are editable overlays from the finalized Japanese subtitles only, with adequate reading time and no important faces covered. Never bake generated misspelled Japanese into artwork. Direct restrained still-image pans and cuts, not lip-sync as a requirement. Music direction: restrained tense piano through the investigation, warmer strings at the earned reversal, quiet hopeful ending, instrumental with no vocals. SFX are subtle, motivated by real scene action. Never assert existing illustrations, music, subtitles, or output have been reviewed without inspection.
